news.title: U.S. dropping some Canada tariffs, Susan Collins says as trade war looms over Maine Senate race
news.description: The U.S. will issue tariff exemptions on several categories of Canadian imports, Sen. Susan Collins announced Friday.

news.title: Musk's SpaceX is still restricting Starlink in Ukraine and the toll is rising
news.description: Since last week, Ukraine has reported restrictions on a version of Starshield, a version of SpaceX's Starlink, hampering its military operations against Russia.

news.title: Qatar deal to buy U.S. natural gas shows how Iran war has redrawn global energy markets
news.description: The Iran war is transforming global energy markets and benefiting U.S. companies, especially liquified natural gas exporters.
